empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is reusable review guidance an agent follows — its description is what tells an agent when to use it.
create.subtitleFromConventions: This skill is being created from the conventions you approved on the repo scan — edit its name, description, and body below before saving.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Use this skill when reviewing pull requests for test coverage and documentation.
fields.descriptionHint: The description is this skill's interface — it's how an agent decides when the skill applies. Write it as a direct instruction ("Use this when…", "Flag any…", "Always check…"), not a vague summary.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.
file.success: Imported "{name}" (stored as untrusted data). Disabled until you vet + enable it.

archive.label: Skill archive (.zip)
archive.hint: SKILL.md at the archive root, or the single Markdown file if there's exactly one. Executable or script files anywhere in the archive are rejected outright.
archive.dropPlaceholder: Drop a .zip file here, or click to choose one
archive.executableRejected: Archive rejected: contains an executable or script file.
archive.pathTraversalRejected: Archive rejected: contains an unsafe file path.

ambiguous.title: Multiple Markdown files found
ambiguous.body: Pick the one that is this skill's content.

archive.success: Imported "{name}" from the archive (stored as untrusted data). Disabled until you vet + enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

community.comingSoon: Community skill search is coming soon — this is a preview of the catalog browser.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.injectionBanner: INJECTION DETECTED — DO NOT ENABLE: This skill contains prompt injection patterns. It has been automatically blocked.
preview.injectionDisabledHint: Remove the flagged patterns from the body before this skill can be enabled.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.runOnEvalsDisabledHint: Eval pipeline isn't built yet in this course.
preview.contextHint: Select Markdown documents under the repository's configured context roots (specs/docs/insights) for this skill to carry into an agent's review context. Selection only — documents are never edited here.

stats.title: Stats
stats.loadError: Could not load this skill's stats.

empty.title: Not linked to any agent
empty.body: Attach this skill to an agent to start seeing usage stats.

range.matchedPrs: {count, plural, one {# PR} other {# PRs}} matched

stats.pullFrequencyNote: Pull frequency is the share of reviewed PRs with a finding citing this skill — a proxy for actual use, not literal prompt-inclusion tracking.

lowSample.note: Fewer than {min} accept/dismiss decisions — accept rate may not be reliable yet.

stats.noAgents: No agent has this skill linked yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreBody: This replaces the current body with v{version}'s content. Nothing is lost — it creates a new version on top of the current one, same as any other save.
